<USER_REQUEST>
Create a complete CSS file at `d:\excel tools\css\styles.css` (overwrite=true). This is for an India Advertiser Tracker dashboard with these sections:

## Design Requirements
- Premium dark theme (deep navy #0a0e1a backgrounds)
- Glassmorphism cards with backdrop-filter blur
- Google Font: Inter
- Smooth animations and hover effects
- Fully responsive

## Sections to Style

### 1. Header (.app-header)
- Sticky, blur background, logo + actions

### 2. Upload Screen (.upload-screen)
- Centered dropzone with drag-drop styling
- Animated hero text with gradient
- Format badges (.format-badge)

### 3. Dashboard (.dashboard-screen)
- File info bar (.file-info-bar)
- Tab navigation for views (.view-tabs, .view-tab, .view-tab.active)

### 4. Pipeline Overview (.pipeline-section)
- Filter bar with search, POC filter, possibility filter
- Pipeline table (.pipeline-table) - styled data table with:
  - Sortable column headers
  - Progress bars for possibility %
  - Color-coded possibility (green >80%, amber 50-80%, red <50%)
  - Highlighted total row
- Pipeline stats cards (.pipeline-stats)

### 5. Campaign Cards Grid (.campaigns-grid)
- Cards (.campaign-card) showing campaign KPIs
- Mini sparkline area for each card
- Status badges (active, paused)
- Hover lift effect

### 6. Campaign Detail (.campaign-detail)
- Back button
- KPI summary cards row (.kpi-row, .kpi-card)
- Daily data table (.data-table) - sortable, paginated
- Charts area (.charts-grid, .chart-card)
- Search/filter bar

### 7. Comparison View (.comparison-section)
- Multi-select campaign picker
- Comparison chart area
- Metric selector tabs

### 8. Common Components
- Buttons: .btn, .btn-primary (gradient indigo), .btn-secondary (glass), .btn-ghost, .btn-danger, .btn-sm
- Toast notifications (.toast-container, .toast, .toast-success/error/info)
- Loading overlay (.loading-overlay, .spinner)
- Pagination (.pagination, .page-btn, .page-btn.active)
- Search inputs (.search-input, .search-wrapper)
- Select/dropdown filters (.filter-select)
- Empty state (.empty-state)
- Stat cards (.stat-card, .stat-label, .stat-value, .stat-sub)
- Data table (.data-table th, td, tbody tr:hover, .row-num, .cell-number)
- Scrollbar styling

### Color palette for chart accents:
--accent-indigo: #6366f1
--accent-violet: #8b5cf6
--accent-cyan: #22d3ee
--accent-emerald: #34d399
--accent-amber: #fbbf24
--accent-rose: #fb7185
--accent-blue: #60a5fa

### Animations:
@keyframes fadeInUp, slideInRight, fadeOut, spin, pulse
Staggered card animations

### Special elements:
- .possibility-bar (progress bar inside pipeline table)
- .possibility-high (green), .possibility-medium (amber), .possibility-low (red)
- .campaign-status.active, .campaign-status.paused
- .sparkline-container
- .metric-tag (small colored tags for metrics)
- .comparison-picker (multi-select area)
- .kpi-card with colored top border (nth-child colors)
- Responsive breakpoints at 1200px, 1024px, 768px, 480px

Make the CSS comprehensive and production-ready. Use CSS variables for all colors. Include the @import for Google Fonts Inter.
</USER_REQUEST>
